correctness.rationale: For complex Lp, 1<p<2, a=1/q<σ<b=1/p, eigenvectors e_t=x^{σ+it−1}(1−x)^{−σ−it} have finite Beta norm B(p(σ−a),p(b−σ)) and eigenvalue 1/(σ+it). A continuous dual annihilator g∈Lq gives holomorphic F(s)=∫g(x)x^{s−1}(1−x)^−s dx bounded on any substrip; under z↦tanh(πz/(4δ)), zeros at pairwise distinct real t_n violate disk Blaschke summability if ∑exp(−π|t_n|/(2δ))=∞, hence F vanishes. Logistic substitution makes F a Fourier transform of integrable H, giving g=0 by uniqueness and dense span by Hahn–Banach. Arithmetic finite coset Γ⊂∪(θ_j+hZ), L=2π/h, supplies independent compactly supported annihilators ∏(τ_L−e^{iθ_jL})φ with disjoint translated supports, hence infinite codimension. For c log n, c<2w/π choose δ>πc/2 and exponent≤1, opposite to hn. Independent finite factor-root check confirms 33 zeros but is not a functional-analytic proof.
